name: devsecops-mcp-server
description: Read-only MCP server for DevSecOps scan results: list, read, summarize for AI triage, evaluate the security policy and render reports. Scans are run by CI (devsecops-scan CLI), never by this server.
author: jmstar85

tools.name: list_scans
tools.description: List stored scan results with severity summaries

tools.name: get_scan_result
tools.description: Read one scan result, filtered by severity and paginated

tools.name: summarize_findings
tools.description: Group findings by rule across scans for AI triage, with the policy decision

tools.name: generate_security_report
tools.description: Render a consolidated markdown, json or sarif report
